description: DNA evidence contradicting defense theory with weak counterarguments

input.problem_statement: Client charged with assault. Defense claims mistaken identity. Prosecution has DNA from crime scene matching client with 99.9% probability. Client has no explanation for DNA presence.

legal_arguments.title: Mistaken identity
legal_arguments.argument: Victim identified wrong person in lineup
potential_counterarguments: DNA evidence conclusively places client at scene
Victim injury consistent with client's height/build

legal_arguments.title: Chain of custody issues
legal_arguments.argument: DNA sample may have been contaminated
potential_counterarguments: No documented chain of custody breaks

weaknesses: DNA evidence destroys mistaken identity defense

adverse_precedents.description: Courts highly value DNA evidence with >99% match

procedural_risks.description: May need expensive DNA expert to challenge testing

validation_notes: Should score 75-90 (high risk) due to devastating DNA evidence (99.9% match), both arguments critically weak, no explanation for DNA presence, courts heavily favor DNA evidence.
